text.text_excerpt: I was happy to hear that there was a new hamburger restaurant opening up in Lakeview, but I was a little surprised that they chose a location on Harrison Avenue almost directly across the street from Lakeview Harbor; a well established local hamburger favorite. However, Jaeger Burger can definitely hold its own, and definitely lives up to the "NOLA famous" Jaeger name. The restaurant is very small, and if you didn't know its exact location, you could drive by it and never even notice it, as it is "sandwiched" between Reginelli's restaurant and Parlay's bar. Upon entering the front door, you are greeted by a very small dining room (2 x 4 tops & 5x 2 tops), all in fairly close proximity. Bu...

Holy hamburger! This place is cooking up a great one! Sunday afternoon, looking for a late lunch, stopped in Jaeger Burger for the first time. First off, the lady (wish I got her name) who was running the whole show was impressive. She took orders, bussed tables, seated us, ran orders to Parlay's next door. That's another thing, apparently if you are drinking next door and make an order they will walk it over to you. That's good service. Since I wasn't starving I got the 4oz Old Fashioned Burger. Even if I was seriously hungry, I would still order this one. It is the perfect size! Just enough to satisfy without making you so stuffed it hurts. The burger was juicy, had great flavor, and th...

Small hole in the wall in lakeview. super tiny but cozy feeling. no liquor liscense but you can bring drinks from parlay next door (same owner) nice server who will give you good tips. she recommended i get the hand cut fries for my cheese fries and she was right. they were awesome. they layer the effort so no fry is without cheese. classy. i got hte jager burger dressed. awesome big bun that is better than a normal bun but i cant really describe it. the bun is bigger than the burger which could bother some people but i like carbs. i got AMERICAN cheese cuz i am a purist.
